items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Topics 17:1
items.html: The HaVaYaH of its inner light is vocalized only in its four simple letters: the Yod with a Cholam, the Hey with a Segol, the Vav with a Patach, and the last Hey with a Segol. And the HaVaYaH of the first surrounding is vocalized: three Cholam points in the letters of the Yod, two Segol points in the letters of the Hey, three Patachin in the letters of the Vav, and two Segols in the letters of the Hey. And the HaVaYaH of the upper surrounding: in the three letters of the Yod, three Patachin; in the two letters of the Hey, Segol and Patach; in the three letters of the Vav, three Patachin; and in the two letters of the Hey, Segol and Patach. (Vol. 1, p. 316, Item 47).
